name: (🌲) untitled gubby game
desc:
everyone love gubby... we love gubby.. become a gubby. 🐇
untitled gubby game is a game where you can become a bunny named gubby, but that's not all... create stories with your favorite characters, dance famous trends, explore the map, and more...

- 🔥 there are currently 250+ skins, 100+ emotes... and more!
- 👆 drag & drop gubbies anywhere with your mouse or finger... you can turn this off in settings!

- ❤️ like and favorite the game to support us!
- 🎁 join our group to get 30+ cat skins and a badge!

- 🛠️ game is in active development, bugs may occur... we are actively working to fix them!

players engaging in inappropriate activity are actively moderated, report them to us through the support server.
